_help: Fill in your real values, then run: node scripts/personalize.js. This rewrites the placeholder domain, social links, author, contact details, full-template URL and agency URL across public/, package.json, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and the light edition. Re-run any time you change a value. To rename the studio itself, search-and-replace 'AuraDesign' across public/*.html (see docs/customization.md).
fullSiteComment: Where the PAID template demo is hosted (no trailing slash). Used in canonical/OG/sitemap/robots.
lightSiteComment: Where the FREE light demo is hosted (no trailing slash).
fullTemplateComment: Your paid product page on Gumroad. The free edition links here.
agencyComment: Your agency / services site. The 'Hire us' CTAs point here.
contactAddress: Your Street 1, Your City, Your Country
contactComment: Shown in the About page 'Direct contact' block. The address is also used in the embedded map link.
formspreeComment: Optional. For the STATIC demo's contact form, paste your Formspree endpoint (https://formspree.io/f/XXXX). Leave empty to use the Node backend instead.
